messages:
maya: Heads up — after the auto-update pushed last night some localtest runs started seeing intermittent 401s during concurrent redwoodctl login attempts. Happening on mac/linux, not yet repro'd on windows.
alex: ugh. any repro steps?
maya: start 3 localtest instances in parallel doing `redwoodctl login --headless` in the same user. about 1/3 runs fail with 'unauthorized: token not found'.
sam: can you paste the exact error?
maya: sure —
```
Error: api: unauthorized (401)
  at auth/manager.go:142
  caused by: credential helper returned empty token
```
jen: sounds like the credential helper/rotation path race we fixed before, but weird that update caused it. did the update touch ~/.redwood/config or credential-helper binary?
maya: the auto-updater replaced the binary but also rewrote ~/.redwood/config with default perms (600 -> 644) for a brief moment during swap, then chmod back. suspected window where helper couldn't read socket.
alex: oh — so file perms flip during hot-swap. that could break concurrent processes that open/creds.
ci-bot: Note: last successful deploy 2026-03-22T03:12Z (updater v1.3.9)
sam: can you try with `REDWOODCTL_LOCALTEST_DISABLE_AUTOUPDATE=1` to rule out the updater?
maya: tried that — no failures after disabling update. 0/200 parallel attempts failed. with updater enabled 18/200 failed.
jen: repro is solid then. probable root: updater does atomic replace by writing tmp file then mv, but it also briefly resets config dir permissions when migrating legacy files. concurrent login path expects stable file perms and atomic socket ownership.
alex: quick mitigation — add a retry in credential helper on empty token with small jitter and exponential backoff. low risk and buys us time.
sam: agreed. also patch updater to avoid touching config perms unless necessary and do it off-main-thread or with lockfile.
maya: created a minimal test harness and a failing trace: `./localtest-runner --concurrency 4 --repeat 50 --cmd "redwoodctl login --headless"` — will drop into shared gist.
jen: thanks. please open a tiny RFC: updater-perms-lock + helper-retry. include metrics we saw (401 rate with/without).
maya: on it. I'll include exact log snippets and the test harness. tagging @alex @sam for follow-ups. :+1:
alex: also add an e2e in CI that runs the harness once per release to catch regressions.
ci-bot: CI note: flaky-parallel-login test added to canary pipeline (will run nightly).
sam: timeline? can we hotfix helper retry today and put updater patch in next week?
jen: helper retry LGTM for hotfix. make it configurable via `REDWOODCTL_AUTH_MAX_RETRY` and default low.
maya: filing PR now. thanks all.
